messages:
Lina: Quick drop 1-line 'risk & hedge' micro-templates for OKRs and self-reviews. Goal: help folks surface realistic risks, fallbacks, and support asks without long paragraphs. Pasteables below. Feedback?

Owen: Love this. Can you show a dev example + a product example?

Lina: Added both + a manager coaching line. Kept each item to 1-2 lines.

Priya: Small ask: include a very short metric checkpoint line (e.g., week-3 signal) so calibration can validate midway.

Lina: Good call  added a 'checkpoint' 1-liner for each template.

Marcus: Can we have a private note line managers can use to record accommodations/blocks?

Lina: Yup  private manager-note pasteable included too.

people-ops-bot: Saved to /templates/self-review/risk-hedge-microtiles  public

Lina: Pasteables (copy-paste into OKR, self-review, or manager notes):
- Dev risk & hedge (1-2 lines):
  - Risk: "Risk: dependent on infra quota for perf workers; may delay canary by 2 sprints."
  - Hedge: "Hedge: ship scoped perf-only MVP + manual sampling if quota delayed."
  - Checkpoint (wk3): "Checkpoint: perf harness shows no regression at 25% traffic by week 3."

- Product risk & hedge (1-2 lines):
  - Risk: "Risk: user research sample may be too small to validate retention lift."
  - Hedge: "Hedge: run parallel qualitative sessions + broaden cohort; fallback to feature flag rollouts."
  - Checkpoint (wk3): "Checkpoint: directional NPS lift in target cohort or pivot plan ready."

- Hiring/ops goal (1-2 lines):
  - Risk: "Risk: offer acceptance variance due to comp band mismatch this quarter."
  - Hedge: "Hedge: prioritize critical roles for higher-band offers and expand candidate slate."
  - Checkpoint (wk3): "Checkpoint: acceptance rate >75% for prioritized cohort or escalation plan engaged."

- Manager private-note (1 line, for manager-only context):
  - "Private: employee on phased return; adjust timeline expectations and document accommodation in HR ticket #1234."

- Fallback-line (1L, paste into self-review if needed):
  - "Fallback: if runway constrained, shift scope to a measurable MVP that preserves core outcome by EOD of Q."

- One-line manager coaching prompts (paste into 1:1):
  - "Which risk worries you most and what's the smallest test we can run this sprint?"
  - "Who do you need me to unblock this week to hit the wk3 checkpoint?"

Owen: These are concise and usable. Can people-ops add a tiny example for how to write the checkpoint as a metric? e.g., 'p95 < 300ms at 25% canary'

Lina: Added an example metric phrasing note in the templates doc.

Priya: :white_check_mark: I'll pilot the dev template with two teams and report back at calibration.

people-ops-bot: Broadcast scheduled for Tuesday 10am PT to #managers with link to template.
